purpose: Upload 上传; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandUpload](../../lib/src/components/upload.dart), [IslandUploadFile](../../lib/src/components/upload_types.dart), [IslandUploadSource](../../lib/src/components/upload_types.dart), [IslandUploadChange](../../lib/src/components/upload_types.dart), [IslandUploadCancellation](../../lib/src/components/upload_types.dart), [IslandUploadTransfer](../../lib/src/components/upload_types.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten. Platform integration signatures are defined separately in lib/animal_island_upload_platform.dart; the core accepts typed IO callbacks.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Host list is authoritative. Insertion precedes transport; each progress transaction waits for parent acknowledgement. Accepted removal, source replacement or disposal cancels only owned jobs. Preflight is serialized and generation-bound, including error delivery afterdisable/disposal. Removal result/error delivery additionally requires the same current file source. Disabling invalidates pending selection/removal intents; already accepted transport jobs retain their existing lifetime.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win. Modal Tab traversal consumes forward and reverse keys even when a closed loop keeps the same target or contains no actions. One shared boundary in the existing action module delegates order to the existing FocusScope, owns one skipped non-semantic target for an otherwise empty scope, and removes its borrowed-scope listener and owned node on disposal. It does not inspect children, add another FocusScope or replace a caller-owned focus target. IslandDialogRoute now defaults explicitly to TraversalEdgeBehavior.closedLoop; an explicitly supplied non-closed-loop policy, including null inheritance from Navigator, remains authoritative. Drawer, Loading, showIslandModal and the shared preview/alert route consume this same behavior. Actual Web keyboard and Windows/AT validation remain separate from widget tests.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. Status content and preview/delete actions own opaque pale backings above arbitrary thumbnail slots. Transparent tip defaults inherit the host theme. Hidden hover controls reject pointer hits while keyboard focus reveals the same subtree. Preview route uses shared opaque displacement and a visible close focus ring; component retains cancellation and route ownership. Generic previews and Gallery alert callbacks reuse public IslandDialogRoute, the sole owner of opaque displacement and reduced-motion settlement. The creator pushes on the root Navigator and retains exact-route lifetime; builder retains content, semantics and surface. Existing showIslandModal scale entry remains its separate reference contract. Dashed strokes use the single public foundation painter under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke. This component retains its existing shape, color, width, dash/gap, state and content ownership; no second contour loop or consumer-private import.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.when: Parent rejects, removes/replaces an ID, disables, or unmounts
scenarios.then: No unaccepted transfer begins or stale file is revived. Cancelled selection/preflight/removal intents do not deliver stale error callbacks; a pending removal is also bound to current file source identity. Current errors report once. Accepted removal/source replacement/disposal cancels owned transfers; disabling alone retains already accepted transfers.

scenarios.given: Picker and drag batches with accept/multiple/maxCount and asynchronous beforeUpload
scenarios.when: Batches overlap or maxCount=1 replaces a file
scenarios.then: Both input paths enforce the same rules, keep deterministic order and emit exact excess files; replacement cancels only the replaced job.

scenarios.given: A request emits many progress events in one frame
scenarios.when: The host acknowledges changes and the request completes
scenarios.then: Progress is coalesced to the newest value; terminal success follows without draining obsolete per-event frame work.

scenarios.given: A positive logical border and the local MediaQuery DPR
scenarios.when: The component or its Gallery reference frame resolves a border
scenarios.then: IslandTheme.borderWidth is the unique owner: whole physical pixels rounded down, minimum one physical pixel. DPR1 appearance is retained; text line boxes and counts are not border metrics.

scenarios.given: The relevant owned state and actual supported background, including transition frames
scenarios.when: Focus, hover, entry, exit or reduced motion changes
scenarios.then: Status content and preview/delete actions own opaque pale backings above arbitrary thumbnail slots. Transparent tip defaults inherit the host theme. Hidden hover controls reject pointer hits while keyboard focus reveals the same subtree. Preview route uses shared opaque displacement and a visible close focus ring; component retains cancellation and route ownership.

scenarios.given: The component-owned modal boundary, or its registered Gallery alert callback, with zero/one/multiple actions
scenarios.when: Forward/reverse Tab, activation, dismissal, rejected close or owner removal occurs
scenarios.then: Closed loops consume Tab without leaving the modal; callbacks fire once and accepted close restores origin. Explicit route traversal overrides survive, opaque child identity/styles remain, and owned focus resources are cleaned up.

scenarios.given: The existing dashed recipe in each supported size, applicable state and target pixel ratio, with opaque content
scenarios.when: Render and update the same component, including its current hover/press/focus and stroke-width recipes where applicable
scenarios.then: The contour, final short dash and inset match the unchanged recipe; all drawing uses the shared public foundation mechanism. Content geometry, callback/focus behavior and lifecycle remain unchanged under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke.
